description: Catalogs derived from the user-supplied resources in this workspace.
transformations: Combined seven Makera milling libraries; excluded standalone holders and lasers.
Kept the supplied metric Genmitsu copy to avoid duplicate inch representations.
Named every tool by style and size in its source unit; the vendor's description is kept as vendor-description.
Set each catalog's vendor name, took SpeTool product IDs from the catalog numbers in their descriptions and moved coatings from names to coating.

Removed float noise from geometry (1.499999999999994 became 1.5) and merged records that describe the same tool, such as SpeTool single tools and five-packs or a Genmitsu bit in several kits; a merged tool keeps every product ID and preset (mergedDuplicates).
Corrected the dimensions that contradict the vendors' own product pages or descriptions (corrections); presets, holders, shafts and source units are otherwise unchanged.
Expressions are inert source metadata and were never evaluated; description, product ID and vendor expressions follow the tidied values.
Converted the transcribed Dreanique TRS dimension tables to Fusion thread mills; each item code is checked against its pitch, cutting diameter and shank cells.

Dreanique thread mills have one flute and one profile (NOF and NT 1), as the code key states; the right hand, 60 degree ISO metric profile and absent coolant supply are assumed, as the tables do not state them. L1 is the shoulder length. Neck diameter, flute and body lengths, tool numbers and cutting presets are not in the tables and are left out.

Converted the Dreanique W2B dimension table, from the Dreanique Official Store's AliExpress listing (the tools' product link), to Fusion ball end mills; each item code is checked against its radius and flute length cells, and the listing's own drawings of 13 of the sizes agree with the table.

Dreanique W2B ball end mills have two carbide flutes, as the listing states; the right hand and absent coolant supply are assumed. D1 is the cutting diameter, L1 the flute length, D the shank diameter and L the overall length. Shoulder, neck and body lengths, tool numbers and cutting presets are not in the table and are left out, except where SpeTool supplies them (below). When the Wayback Machine archived the listing (31 August 2022) it offered 13 of the table's 17 sizes, all but W2B-R0.5-L04, W2B-R0.75-L06, W2B-R5.0-L45 and W2B-R6.0-L45.

Dreanique's W2B presets (named Recommended) come from the recommended cutting parameters on the W2B listing: the low end of its spindle speed and feed ranges, with the ranges in each preset's description. The table gives no material, depth, plunge feed or stepover. Ø3 takes the Ø2.5 row, which the Ø3.1 row equals.

Converted Dreanique's SP1F dimension table to Fusion flat end mills with one flute (O-flutes). Its D3.1 codes and 3.1 mm cells are 3.175 mm (1/8″) cutters, as Dreanique's DSA1F table and SpeTool's descriptions of its SP1F-D3.1 bits give. Each has three presets from Dreanique's SP1F/DSP1F cutting parameter table: soft wood and plastic, acrylic (compressed air) and aluminium and copper (compressed air; the table allows air or mist). They take the low end of the speed and feed ranges; the wood and acrylic stepdown is the low end of the depth range, the aluminium stepdown the slotting limit, 0.5 × D. The listing's other SP1F table, with narrower ranges in two groups, is not used. The SP1F listing's address is not known, so these tools have no product link.

Converted Dreanique's DSA1F (one flute) and DAU3E (three flutes) dimension tables to DLC-coated Fusion flat end mills for aluminium. DSA1F presets (Aluminium and copper, with mist) come from the DSA1F column of the cutting parameter table on the DSA1F listing: the low end of the speed and feed ranges and the slotting depth, 0.5 × D. DAU3E tools have no presets, as no cutting parameters were found for them.

The DSA1F listing's 2022 table gave shorter overall lengths for D4.0-L12, L15, L17 and L22 (45 mm), D6.0-L25 (50), D8.0-L32 (60) and D10.0-L42 (85), 3.1 mm for the D3.1 cutters and a 12 mm flute for D8.0-L17; the catalog follows the current table, which also adds seven sizes.
For every Dreanique family, each item code is checked against its diameter and flute length cells; the right hand and absent coolant supply are assumed.

Converted Dreanique's ECP3F dimension table to Fusion chamfer mills with three flutes and a pointed tip, in 60, 90 and 120 degree included angles (A; the taper angle is half of it). D is both the shank and the cutting diameter, as the drawing and SpeTool's descriptions give, and L the overall length. The flute length is the cone's length, D/2 divided by the tangent of half the angle, rounded to 0.001 mm. The table calls the tools coated but names no coating, so coating is left out. The ECP3F listing's address is not known, so these tools have no product link. Only the four sizes SpeTool also sells (below) have a preset, as no Dreanique cutting parameters were found.

SpeTool sells Dreanique tools under its own product IDs, with Dreanique's item codes as SKUs (W2B, SP1F, SA1F, SP2FC, ST2F, AU3E and more). Eight are in this catalog, matched by SKU and dimensions: W04801 is W2B-R3.0-L24, W04802 is W2B-R4.0-L32, W03501 is SP1F-D3.1-L15, W03502 is SP1F-D3.1-L12, W06506 is ECP3F-D4.0-R60, W06507 is ECP3F-D4.0-R90, W06508 is ECP3F-D6.0-R60 and W06509 is ECP3F-D6.0-R90. Their Dreanique records take SpeTool's preset (named SpeTool default) and its body, shoulder and assembly gauge lengths; SpeTool's tool numbers are left out. SpeTool's W03503 record describes the uncoated SA1F-D6.0-L22, not the DLC-coated DSA1F-D6.0-L22 (SpeTool sells a DLC variant under the same number), and W03504 and W03505 are SpeTool-coated SP1F bits (SP1FT), so none of those three is copied. SpeTool sells no other W2B or ECP3F size and no thread mills. SpeTool's W06508 flute length, 5.2 mm, is the ECP3F-D6.0-R60 cone length (5.196 mm) rounded.
Translated SpeTool's Chinese preset name 默认预设 (default preset) to Default, as its other default presets are named.

The Makera Wired Probe 2.0's dimensions in makera-probe.json, and its model public/models/makera-wired-probe-2.glb (scripts/wired-probe.mjs), are estimated from Makera's product photos, scaled by the known diameters of its shank adapters; they are not measured.

The Makera 3D Probe's dimensions in makera-probe.json, and its model public/models/makera-3d-probe.glb (scripts/3d-probe.mjs), are estimated from Makera's product photos of the Makera 3D Wired Probe, scaled by its 1/8″ shank; its Ø2 mm ruby ball, the Ø3 mm base of its M2 stylus and its USB-C port agree with that scale. They are not measured. The model leaves the cable out, as the probe is drawn without it. Its post-processor number, 9999, is the tool number the Z1 firmware gives the 3D probe (ATCHandler.cpp).

corrections.evidence: SpeTool's W04801 preset plunges at 13333 mm/min, over three times its 4000 mm/min cutting feed. Its ramp feed is 1333 mm/min, and W04802's preset plunges at its ramp feed, a third of its cutting feed, so 13333 has one 3 too many; the feed per revolution follows the plunge feed. The Dreanique W2B-R3.0-L24, the same tool, takes the corrected preset.
